about.title: About Hawaii State Department of Education
about.content: The Hawaii State Department of Education, also known as HIDOE, operates Hawaii public schools statewide. The official school calendar helps families across the islands plan student attendance dates, breaks, state holidays, teacher workdays, and the end of each semester.

about.title: How to Use This Hawaii Public Schools Calendar
about.content: Use this page for statewide Hawaii public school calendar planning, including the first day of school, fall break, winter break, spring break, state holidays, institute day windows, teacher workdays, and the last day for students. Families should confirm school-specific events, athletics, graduation ceremonies, and multitrack schedules directly with their school.

planningTips.title: Planning Tips for Hawaii Public School Families
content: The statewide calendar includes 180 student days, but two instructional days are converted to non-student days for school planning and collaboration.
Institute day is listed as one no-student day during a designated week, with the exact date determined by island.
State holidays such as Statehood Day, Kuhio Day, and observed federal holidays can affect childcare and travel planning.
Check whether your school follows the standard statewide calendar or a multitrack calendar before booking interisland or mainland travel.

customSections.label: About HIDOE Calendar Structure
customSections.content: Hawaii's statewide public school calendar lists separate student and teacher work years. It also identifies fall intersession, winter recess, spring recess, state holidays, quarter endings, teacher workdays, and institute day windows. The official calendar notes that one institute day during the listed week is a no-student day and that the exact island date is determined separately.

customSections.label: Hawaii State Department of Education Profile
customSections.content: HIDOE is Hawaii's statewide public school system. Its academic calendar sets the statewide student attendance framework and teacher work year planning dates.

customSections.label: Which Hawaii School Calendar Should Families Follow?
customSections.content: HIDOE publishes the official statewide academic calendar used for most Hawaii public school planning. Families should use that calendar for student work year dates, fall break, winter break, spring break, state holidays, teacher workdays, and last-day timing, then confirm school-level details directly with their school.

customSections.label: Hawaii Public Schools Calendar vs School-Specific Calendars
customSections.content: The Hawaii public schools calendar is the source for statewide student dates and state holidays. It does not replace school-specific notices for campus events, athletics, testing windows, commencement ceremonies, complex-area notices, multitrack schools, or emergency schedule updates.

districtFaqs.q: Which Hawaii public schools calendar does this page summarize?
districtFaqs.a: This page summarizes the official Hawaii State Department of Education school calendar for the listed school years.

districtFaqs.q: Does the Hawaii public schools calendar apply statewide?
districtFaqs.a: Yes, it is the statewide Hawaii public schools calendar. Families should still verify school-specific events, multitrack schedules, athletics, testing, and graduation details with their individual school.

districtFaqs.q: What is the Hawaii DOE institute day?
districtFaqs.a: The official calendar lists an Educational Officer and Teacher Institute Day window. One day during the listed week is a no-student day, and the exact date is determined by island.

districtFaqs.q: Does every Hawaii public school follow the same calendar?
districtFaqs.a: Most Hawaii public schools use the statewide HIDOE academic calendar, but families should check whether their school uses a multitrack calendar or has school-specific dates for testing, graduation, athletics, or emergencies.

districtFaqs.q: Are Hawaii charter schools included in this calendar?
districtFaqs.a: Not necessarily. Hawaii charter schools may publish their own school calendars, so families should verify attendance dates directly with the charter school.

districtFaqs.q: Does the Hawaii public schools calendar include teacher workdays?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. The HIDOE calendar includes teacher workdays, teacher work year dates, and institute day windows, but school-level schedules can add details that are not shown in the statewide calendar summary.

districtFaqs.q: When should families book Hawaii travel around school breaks?
districtFaqs.a: Families often plan travel around Fall Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, and summer break timing. Confirm the official HIDOE calendar and school-specific notices before booking flights, hotels, interisland travel, or nonrefundable reservations.

districtFaqs.q: Where can I download the Hawaii school calendar PDF?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official Hawaii State Department of Education school calendar page or the PDF link on this page to download the official calendar source for the selected school year.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify Hawaii public school calendar updates?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official Hawaii State Department of Education school calendar page and school announcements for final confirmation. MySchoolDates is an independent reference and is not affiliated with HIDOE.
